input: Start a sourdough starter from scratch at home

gold.taskTitle: Build a Sourdough Starter From Scratch at Home
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create and maintain a sourdough starter from scratch at home using basic ingredients.

questions.title: What type of flour do you have available?
questions.description: Knowing the flour type (all-purpose, whole wheat, rye, etc.) affects the starter recipe and fermentation speed.

questions.title: Have you ever made a sourdough starter before?
questions.description: Understanding the user's prior experience helps determine how detailed the guidance needs to be.

questions.title: What is the typical room temperature in your home?
questions.description: Ambient temperature directly controls fermentation speed and feeding schedules.

questions.title: How many days do you have before you want to bake?
questions.description: A sourdough starter typically takes 5 to 14 days to become active enough to use.

questions.title: How much starter do you want to maintain long-term?
questions.description: The target volume affects the quantity of flour and water needed for each feeding.

questions.title: Do you plan to use a scale or measuring cups?
questions.description: Weight-based measurements are more precise for sourdough; this determines which instructions to provide.

questions.title: Will you store the starter at room temperature or in the fridge?
questions.description: Storage method determines how often the starter needs to be fed and how it is maintained.
